Files in this directory are an unmodified copy of

    https://github.com/openai/guided-diffusion
    guided_diffusion/{unet.py, nn.py, fp16_util.py, script_util.py}

released under the MIT licence (see LICENSE in this directory).

They are vendored (rather than re-implemented) so that the public checkpoints
used by the paper

    256x256_classifier.pt
    https://openaipublic.blob.core.windows.net/diffusion/jul-2021/256x256_classifier.pt

    256x256_diffusion_uncond.pt
    https://openaipublic.blob.core.windows.net/diffusion/jul-2021/256x256_diffusion_uncond.pt

load with exactly the architecture they were trained with.  Nothing in the
paper's own repository (blacklisted) is used.

Differences from upstream: none.  The only change is that the relative import
``from .fp16_util import ...`` resolves inside this package.
